system.description: You can have one cybernetic implant without getting a permanent Trauma. You start with the cybernetic Neural Interface, which grants Neural-Link: advantage on rolls to manipulate and bypass computer systems. You cannot change it later.
system.gmNotes: PT1 prints the Transhuman base Hardwired as a generic text (choose a Tier 2 cybernetic at GM discretion for starting equipment); the OCR placed it in the Dustrooted block.
